Hi Markus,

We're evaluating hosted inference providers for an internal triage assistant and some user-facing summarization features. Can you send your standard per-1M token pricing split by input vs output for the hosted API? Specifically:

- Baseline per-1M input tokens
- Baseline per-1M output tokens

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ravi Kumar <ravi.k@carelogic.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: per-1M token IO rates + model roster for hosted API

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and the attachment. High level answers below; I attached our baseline ratecard (PDF) and a quick model roster link. Happy to hop on a 30m call to walk through the numbers.

Baseline hosted API (standard public catalog) — per 1M tokens (USD):
- Input tokens: $0.40 / 1M tokens
- Output tokens: $1.10 / 1M tokens
- Streaming responses: output token rate applies; no additional streaming surcharge for HTTP streaming (WS or SSE patterns are supported)
- Embeddings: $0.85 / 1M input tokens (note embeddings counted on input size only)
- Fine-tuned variants: model-specific uplift (typically +10–25% depending on model size & memory bandwidth) — we can call this out per-model once we know which base model is desired

Model guidance (short):
- Latency-sensitive generation: Redwood-Gen-XL (good balance of latency/cost)
- High-quality long-form: Redwood-Gen-XXL (higher output costs, better coherence on long context)
- Mid-cost, lower-latency: Redwood-Gen-M
- Embeddings: Redwood-Embed-Base and Redwood-Embed-Compact (compact is cheaper for high-volume semantic search)

Notes:
- Our published baseline is what I shared above; we can offer pilot credits or short-term discounts depending on committed volume and use case. For a 6–8 week pilot at ~5M/mo we often provide a pilot credit (e.g., $2k–$5k) and a 10–15% introductory discount on unit rates.
- For predictable spikes, we recommend enabling burst capacity or reserving a small Dedicated pool — pricing/commit for Dedicated differs (we can outline if you want predictable latency during spikes).
- SOC2 Type II: yes (we'll provide the report under NDA). HIPAA: we support HIPAA-ready deployments via Private (VPC) or appropriate DPA on Hosted with BAAs for qualifying customers; I'd like to loop in Security if you want specifics.

Next steps:
1) Do you want the quick call today or tomorrow?
2) Can you confirm expected average/peak tokens per month and whether you'll be using fine-tuning or embeddings?

Attaching: redwood_baseline_ratecard.pdf (baseline IO sheet) and link to model catalog: https://redwood.ai/models/catalog

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 (650) 555-0210
